subject: SIG launch: prefill, stakeholder mapping & next steps (MedAlign)
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Michaels <jm@medalign.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG launch: prefill, stakeholder mapping & next steps (MedAlign)

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for walking us through MedAlign's use cases and where compliance fits into your roadmap. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

- Scope: You confirmed the integration will process identifiable patient records from US customers (no EU EEA residency for primary storage at this stage).
- Compliance asks from your side: SOC 2 report availability, HIPAA/BAA posture, and an initial vendor security questionnaire (SIG or CAIQ).

Action items I promised: 
1) Attach our SIG prefill template to speed the intake (see attachment). If you prefer CAIQ instead, say the word and I’ll send that template.
2) Could you confirm whether MedAlign will sign a BAA for PHI processing? That will determine the scope of the evidence we pull.
3) Please share a simple network diagram (VPC boundaries, third-party connections) — a one-page PDF is perfect.
4) Suggested follow-up: 30-minute technical + security sync next Wed (08/25) to walk through the prefill and owners.

If helpful I can prefill portions of the SIG (hosting, org contact info) — that typically cuts reviewer time in half.

Attachment: SIG_prefill_template.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference — inference that scales
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-18T17:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG launch: prefill, stakeholder mapping & next steps (MedAlign)

Thanks — quick technical clarifications before we send the prefill: 

On Wed, Aug 18, 2026 at 3:12 PM Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Great to meet earlier — thanks for walking us through MedAlign's use cases and where compliance fits into your roadmap.

A few points I want to confirm so we scope the SIG correctly: 
- Is MedAlign expecting us to cover processing of PHI for both development and production environments, or only production? That affects evidence collection (dev/staging exclusions).
- Encryption: can they confirm whether encryption at rest uses customer-managed keys (CMK) or provider-managed? If CMK — which KMS provider?
- Third parties: they mentioned an analytics vendor (LogStream) — do we need to include our contract with LogStream in the evidence bundle?
- Evidence owner: who at MedAlign will handle handing over docs (SOC 2 report, asset inventory, network diagram)? Name + email would be ideal.

I can take point on the technical evidence (network diagram, architecture statements, config screenshots). Rishi — can you confirm whether our legal team should send a draft BAA now or wait until they commit to a Proof of Concept?

Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Michaels <jm@medalign.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-19T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG launch: prefill, stakeholder mapping & next steps (MedAlign)

Thanks Aisha — good recap. A few answers below, plus attaching the network diagram.

On Wed, Aug 18, 2026 at 5:04 PM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> A few points I want to confirm so we scope the SIG correctly:

Answers from our side: 
- PHI scope: We only plan to send production PHI to Redwood during the POC. Development data is synthetic/obfuscated.
- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report, most recent period ended 2025-12-31. We can share the redacted report with an NDA.
- HIPAA/BAA: We will require a BAA before moving production PHI. Please share your standard BAA; we can loop legal.
- Encryption: Our production DBs are encrypted with provider-managed keys (AWS KMS). We can export KMS key IDs if required.
- Third parties: LogStream is a downstream analytics vendor — we do not expect Redwood to include their contracts in your evidence package.
- Evidence owner: Priya Singh (priya.singh@medalign.com) will coordinate documents.

Attachment: network_diagram_v1.pdf (stub)

We prefer the SIG form; CAIQ not necessary for our procurement. Can you send the SIG prefill and we'll aim to have Priya complete the first pass by next Tue (08/24)? Also available for a sync on 08/25 10:00–10:30 PDT.

Best,
Jordan Michaels
Head of Platform, MedAlign Systems
jm@medalign.com | +1 650-555-0200
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Michaels <jm@medalign.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@medalign.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-19T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG launch: prefill, stakeholder mapping & next steps (MedAlign)

Thanks Jordan — perfect, appreciate the clear answers and the diagram. Quick confirmation of next steps on our side: 

- I will prefill the SIG with company-level info and hosting answers and send the completed XLS to Priya by EOD today (attachment: SIG_prefill_template.xlsx — prefilled stub).
- Karthik will own the technical evidence collection (screenshots/configs/network confirm). Karthik — please plan to have a first-pass tech bundle ready to share in the 08/25 sync.
- Rishi will circulate our standard BAA to Priya for review (Rishi — thanks in advance).
- Priya / Jordan — please aim to complete the remaining SIG fields by 08/24; we’ll review on the 08/25 10:00–10:30 PDT call.

Calendar invite to follow. If anything changes on your end (e.g., SOC 2 NDA gating), flag it and we’ll pause submission.

Attachments: SIG_prefill_template.xlsx (prefill stub)

Thanks again — excited to get this moving.

Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
